components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); font: 700 13px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease; border: 1px solid var(--primary, #176b45); background: var(--primary, #176b45); color: var(--on-primary, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #125537); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #176b45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Edit, cancel, filters and low-emphasis actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); font: 700 13px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d7e2d9); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #172b26); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #eef4ef); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #176b45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, 46px control, primary border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; font: 700 13px system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #172b26); } .ds-input { min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d7e2d9); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #172b26); font: 400 16px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .16s ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover, #a0b6a8); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary, #176b45); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #176b45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Dark brand header with Mint Tab active item (desktop/tablet).
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-active" aria-current="page">My Lists</button><button class="ds-nav-item">Catalog</button><button class="ds-nav-item">Trips</button><button class="ds-nav-item">Settings</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; height: 76px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--header-background, #0a3125); } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 12px); background: transparent; color: var(--on-brand, #fff); font: 700 13px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: var(--mint, #b2e7bc); color: var(--brand, #0a3125); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--mint, #b2e7bc); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Panels and list surfaces: 18px radius, thin border, single ambient shadow.
components.html:
WEEKLY SHOP

Groceries

4 of 9 bought · ₱1,240.00 est.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d7e2d9); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 18px); background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgb(23 43 38 / 4%); color: var(--text, #172b26); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--primary, #176b45); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .07em; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 3px; font-size: 20px; } .ds-card-meta { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-text, #42584e); font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: List Row with Checkmark
components.description: Signature checklist row: large round bought checkmark, name, quantity.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; min-height: 76px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d7e2d9); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 18px); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #172b26); font: 700 16px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .16s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #eef4ef); } .ds-row small { display: block; color: var(--muted-text, #42584e); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-check { appearance: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; margin: 0; border: 2px solid var(--control-border, #8a998b); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-check:checked { border-color: var(--primary, #176b45); background: var(--primary, #176b45); } .ds-check:checked::after { content: "✓"; color: var(--on-primary, #fff); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #176b45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Progress Track
components.description: Shopping progress: 6px pill track with primary fill.
components.css: .ds-progress { width: 240px; height: 6px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--progress-track, #cbd8ca); } .ds-progress span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--primary, #176b45); transition: width .2s ease; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-progress span { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
CartCheck is a pocket notebook carried down the aisle: practical, legible with one hand, and calm enough to trust while you shop. The checklist does the talking. Prices, budgets and totals sit nearby but quieter, because a shopper must be able to finish a trip without them.

The surfaces are paper-like neutrals with one deep green accent, a dark brand-green header, and mint as a small highlight. Forms are soft and steady, with rounded controls and cards, thin borders, a faint ambient shadow and generous touch targets. Built with React, semantic HTML and CSS custom properties; no UI component package.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (deep green, mint in dark mode); everything else is neutral.
Soft and steady forms: 12px controls, 18px cards, 48px touch targets.
Light, Dark and System appearance, chosen in Settings and stored in the browser; System follows the device.
Money and totals in tabular numerals; unknown amounts read as incomplete, never as zero.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Green is the only accent. Mint stays a small highlight; never add a second hue for emphasis.

rules.name: The Words-Not-Color Rule
rules.body: Warnings, errors, over-budget and unknown-price states always carry text. Color is never the only signal. Check every text/background pair against WCAG AA.

rules.name: The Ledger Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every amount, total and count uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: One shadow level only. Hierarchy comes from borders and surface tone, not stacked elevation.

dos: Do keep checklist actions primary and prices and budget visually secondary.
Do use the CSS custom properties in `client/src/styles.css`. Never hard-code a hex value in a component.
Do keep the official wordmark assets in `client/public/`.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`; transitions stay short (0.16–0.2s ease).
Do keep every interactive target at least 44px tall, with a visible focus outline.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue or a UI component library.
Don't signal state by color alone.
Don't show an unknown amount as `0.00`.
Don't stack shadows or add elevation levels beyond the single ambient card shadow.
